Markets.title: Gold edges up as softer crude tempers inflation concerns
Markets.summary: Gold prices rose slightly on Monday due to lower oil prices reducing inflation worries. However, gains remained limited because investors expect the Federal Reserve to maintain higher U.S. interest rates.

Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks open mostly higher, Nvidia probe looms
Markets.summary: Asian stock indexes opened mostly higher following a 4.2% jump in US semiconductor shares on Friday. The rally occurred as speculation eased regarding potential tighter Democratic regulation of the artificial intelligence industry.

Markets.title: Lower crude, global stability to drive market growth in new Samvat: ANMI President Kamlesh Shroff
Markets.summary: India's macroeconomic environment is projected to grow by over seven percent, supporting equity markets during the new Samvat. Falling crude oil prices and reduced geopolitical tensions are expected to strengthen the rupee and attract foreign investors.

Markets.title: Indian economy to grow faster, foreign capital returning to markets: NSE CEO Ashishkumar Chauhan
Markets.summary: The NSE CEO stated that India's economy is growing faster due to strong macroeconomic fundamentals and effective fiscal management. Additionally, domestic financial savings have reached USD 1.4 trillion annually while foreign capital is returning to the markets.

Markets.title: Muhurat trading: Sensex up 320 pts, Nifty crosses 25,100; Tata Steel, Sun Pharma among top gainers
Markets.summary: During the special Muhurat trading session, the Sensex rose 320 points and the Nifty crossed the 25,100 mark. Tata Steel and Sun Pharma were among the top performing gainers of the session.

Markets.title: Diwali turned lucky for these 8 stocks! Investors' wealth more than doubled, returns soar up to 191%
Markets.summary: Despite the Nifty 50 declining nearly 3% since Diwali 2025, eight BSE 500 stocks more than doubled investors' wealth over the past year. ACE Equities data shows Aditya Infotech, HFCL, and Welspun Corp led this rally with returns soaring up to 191%.

Geo-Political.title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
Geo-Political.summary: A surgeon having lunch near Krakow treated a wounded police officer and undoubtedly saved his life. The officer was one of two police personnel hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more people.

Geo-Political.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
Geo-Political.summary: Two trains traveling in the same direction collided outside the city of Giza in Egypt, causing several carriages to derail. The crash resulted in seven deaths and injuries to more than 100 people.

Geo-Political.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
Geo-Political.summary: Millions of people across India are celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights. Celebrations include lighting lamps, setting off fireworks, and sharing traditional sweets.

Geo-Political.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
Geo-Political.summary: Iran has executed three men accused of participating in anti-government protests earlier this year. Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi, and Reza Zanganeh were put to death for charges related to armed unrest.

Geo-Political.title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
Geo-Political.summary: Houthi forces launched fresh strikes that hit an Aramco tower located in the central financial district of the Saudi capital. Footage authenticated by BBC Verify confirmed the resulting damage to the building.

Geo-Political.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
Geo-Political.summary: Voter confidence in New Zealand is exceptionally low amid widespread fatigue and cynicism toward politics. This discontent has resulted in voters abandoning major parties ahead of the country's tightest election in years.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators streamline their workflows and stay competitive in a rapidly evolving landscape.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex reserves fall $2.69 billion to $717 billion: Why RBI is selling dollars and what it means for the rupee
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $2.69 billion to $717.06 billion in the week ending October 30, driven by central bank dollar sales, fund deployment, and valuation changes. The Reserve Bank of India is actively selling dollars to stabilize the rupee against depreciation pressures.

Data & Insights.title: Iran war: IOC to buy crude, LPG carriers as Strait of Hormuz disruptions drive freight costs
Data & Insights.summary: Indian Oil Corporation plans to purchase crude and LPG carriers and explore domestic shipbuilding to counter rising freight costs caused by Strait of Hormuz disruptions. This initiative supports the company's broader strategy to diversify crude supplies, build inventories, and strengthen its energy supply chain.

Data & Insights.title: The midterms give Fed more room to raise rates, mut maybe less reason to do so
Data & Insights.summary: Midterm election results suggest a slowdown in datacenter spending. This reduction in spending could help curb inflation and influence Federal Reserve interest rate decisions.

Data & Insights.title: No fresh curbs on broken rice exports as India banks on steady paddy procurement
Data & Insights.summary: India, the world's largest rice exporter, shipped 8.08 lakh tonnes of broken rice in calendar year 2025 after lifting its previous export ban on March 7, 2025. The government has decided against imposing new restrictions on broken rice exports due to steady paddy procurement.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to report lower treasury income during the second quarter. This elevated yield environment is expected to continue putting pressure on bank earnings in the upcoming December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to launch the full programme next year without additional pilot rounds.

India.title: Delhi-NCR Chokes On Diwali Night As Smoke Engulfs City, AQI Nears 400
India.summary: Delhi-NCR experienced severe air pollution on Diwali night as smoke engulfed the city and the Air Quality Index neared 400. Prior to the festival, the Commission for Air Quality Management had enforced Stage 3 of the Graded Response Action Plan across the region.

India.title: School Assembly News Headlines (November 9): Top National, International News
India.summary: Global news highlights escalating military tensions involving Iran, Israel, and the United States. Reports also cover key political developments taking place across the Middle East.

India.title: HD Kumaraswamy Claims IAS Officer Paid Bribe To Stop Transfer, Points To Minister
India.summary: JD(S) leader HD Kumaraswamy alleged that an IAS officer paid a bribe to prevent a transfer. He supported the claim by reading excerpts from a purported WhatsApp conversation involving the official.

India.title: "Bangladeshis Lying In Wait": Suvendu Adhikari To Security Forces At Bengal Border
India.summary: BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari claimed that Bangladeshi nationals are gathered near the West Bengal border waiting to illegally cross into India. He stated that he observed this using binoculars while accusing them of watching for moments when the Border Security Force is not looking.

India.title: Delhi Air Quality Turns 'Very Poor' On Diwali, To Turn 'Severe'
India.summary: Delhi's air quality dropped to "very poor" on Diwali due to celebrations, vehicular emissions, and stubble burning. The air quality is forecast to worsen to "severe" on Monday.

India.title: Video: Whale Washes Ashore In Goa's Mandrem Beach, Released Into Sea
India.summary: A small whale washed ashore on Mandrem Beach in Goa. A group of volunteers successfully rescued the animal by wrapping it in cloth sheets and dragging it back into the sea.

General.title: 'I treat all these people like they are victims', says doctor who treated Krakow shooting suspect
General.summary: Two doctors eating near Krakow's Main Market Square were forced to treat victims after a gunman began firing at random. One of the treating physicians stated that he treats everyone involved in the shooting as a victim.

General.title: Nandy defends linking Erasmus student scheme to Remembrance Sunday after backlash
General.summary: Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy defended her decision to connect the UK's potential return to the EU Erasmus student scheme with Remembrance Sunday. She stated that rejoining the study and work program would serve as a way to honour wartime sacrifices.

General.title: Woman says Al Fayed's brother drugged and sexually abused her at Highland estate
General.summary: A woman named Jill has alleged that the brother of Mohamed Al Fayed drugged and sexually abused her at the Fayed family's Balnagown estate. She stated that she was flown to the Highland property, where the repeated assaults occurred.

General.title: Maya Jama steps down as host of reality TV show Love Island
General.summary: The presenter tells fans it is "time to throw myself into something new" after recent Celebrity Traitors success.

General.title: Dense fog threatens Monday morning rush-hour disruption
Government looking at banning under-16s from Vinted and eBay
General.summary: The culture secretary confirms reports they could be in the list of platforms set to be banned next March.
